title: fw-wan overview
description: The VyOS edge router: health, WAN and VRF traffic, firewall verdicts, VPN tunnels, system.

panels.title: Reachable (ICMP)
panels.description: Blackbox ICMP probe from mon01 to fw-wan's mgmt address.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Orange in the first hour after a reboot.

panels.title: Exporters
panels.description: node_exporter (vyos-node), frr_exporter (vyos-frr) and Telegraf (vyos-telegraf) on fw-wan.

panels.title: WAN address
panels.description: eth5 (DHCP from Spectrum), from VyOS (status-metrics.py).

panels.title: WAN in
panels.description: eth5 received.

panels.title: WAN out
panels.description: eth5 sent.

panels.title: Conntrack table
panels.description: Tracked connections / nf_conntrack_max. New flows are dropped when it's full.

panels.title: BGP sessions
panels.description: IPv4 unicast BGP sessions from frr_exporter: BORDER-LEAF-18/19 (VRF lylat_service, BGP unnumbered over eth1.1000/eth2.1000) and the haystack peer (VRF vpn_hay). If the exporter is down, all three show 0; check the Exporters stat.

panels.title: VPN tunnels
panels.description: IPsec IKE SAs established and WireGuard peers with a handshake in the last 3 minutes (vpn-metrics.py).

panels.title: VyOS services
panels.description: Daemons VyOS expects for its config (zebra, staticd, bgpd, charon...), from status-metrics.py.

panels.title: Units failed / restarting
panels.description: systemd units that failed, and units stuck activating (crash-looping with Restart=). See the table under System.

panels.title: Firewall drops + rejects
panels.description: Packets dropped or rejected by any rule or default action (input, forward, output and the named chains; IPv4 + IPv6).

panels.title: Interfaces
panels.description: fw-wan's interfaces with the VRF from the config snapshot (default = no VRF; the VLAN parents eth1-3 are in the default VRF). Rates over the last 5 minutes.

targets.expr: max by (host, device, vrf) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_join((node_network_up{host="fw-wan", device!~"lo|pim6reg.*|dum.*"}) unless on (host, device) label_replace(group by (host, vrf) (frr_route_total{host="fw-wan"}), "device", "$1", "vrf", "(.+)"), "hd", ":", "host", "device"), "vrf", "default", "hd", "fw-wan:.*"), "vrf", "guest_vrf", "hd", "fw-wan:(eth3\\.4)"), "vrf", "lylat_service", "hd", "fw-wan:(dum69|eth1\\.1000|eth2\\.1000|eth3\\.5)"), "vrf", "mgmt", "hd", "fw-wan:(eth0)"), "vrf", "vpn_hay", "hd", "fw-wan:(vti69)"), "vrf", "vpn_me", "hd", "fw-wan:(vti1|wg77)"), "vrf", "wan_vrf", "hd", "fw-wan:(dum666|eth5)"), "vrf", "n/a", "vrf", ""))

max by (host, device, ifalias, operstate) ((node_network_info{host="fw-wan", device!~"lo|pim6reg.*|dum.*"}) unless on (host, device) label_replace(group by (host, vrf) (frr_route_total{host="fw-wan"}), "device", "$1", "vrf", "(.+)"))

max by (host, device) ((node_network_mtu_bytes{host="fw-wan", device!~"lo|pim6reg.*|dum.*"}) unless on (host, device) label_replace(group by (host, vrf) (frr_route_total{host="fw-wan"}), "device", "$1", "vrf", "(.+)"))

max by (host, device) ((node_network_speed_bytes{host="fw-wan", device!~"lo|pim6reg.*|dum.*"} * 8 > 0) unless on (host, device) label_replace(group by (host, vrf) (frr_route_total{host="fw-wan"}), "device", "$1", "vrf", "(.+)"))

max by (host, device) ((rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{host="fw-wan", device!~"lo|pim6reg.*|dum.*"}[5m]) * 8) unless on (host, device) label_replace(group by (host, vrf) (frr_route_total{host="fw-wan"}), "device", "$1", "vrf", "(.+)"))

max by (host, device) ((rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{host="fw-wan", device!~"lo|pim6reg.*|dum.*"}[5m]) * 8) unless on (host, device) label_replace(group by (host, vrf) (frr_route_total{host="fw-wan"}), "device", "$1", "vrf", "(.+)"))

max by (host, device) ((rate(node_network_receive_errs_total{host="fw-wan", device!~"lo|pim6reg.*|dum.*"}[5m]) + rate(node_network_transmit_errs_total{host="fw-wan", device!~"lo|pim6reg.*|dum.*"}[5m])) unless on (host, device) label_replace(group by (host, vrf) (frr_route_total{host="fw-wan"}), "device", "$1", "vrf", "(.+)"))

max by (host, device) ((rate(node_network_receive_drop_total{host="fw-wan", device!~"lo|pim6reg.*|dum.*"}[5m]) + rate(node_network_transmit_drop_total{host="fw-wan", device!~"lo|pim6reg.*|dum.*"}[5m])) unless on (host, device) label_replace(group by (host, vrf) (frr_route_total{host="fw-wan"}), "device", "$1", "vrf", "(.+)"))

panels.title: Syslog (without firewall lines)
panels.description: fw-wan's syslog in Loki, notice and above (informational lines are left out: mostly charon's packet chatter; the Logs dashboards show everything), newest first, up to 300 lines. Firewall log lines are on the firewall dashboard.
